data.current_description:
Check which industry categories a search will actually match, before you run it.

Each word comes back as one of:
• `resolved`: with the exact category names a search will filter on
• `unresolved`: no matching category, so a search would match it as profile text instead; `suggestions` lists nearby real categories
• `unverified`: the lookup failed, try again
data.description_suggestion: Validate and resolve industry names to their canonical categories before using them in a people search. Accepts a list of industry terms and returns the resolution status for each: `resolved` (exact category match with canonical names), `unresolved` (no match, with suggestions for similar categories), or `unverified` (lookup failed). Use this to ensure your search filters match intended categories and discover alternative category names.
